Vuelta 2026: KOM Classification

fotobureau Cor VosSantiago Buitrago won the mountains classification at the 2026 Vuelta a España. The Colombian wore the polka-dot jersey from stage 10 onwards and eventually finished 16 points clear of points classification winner Wout van Aert.

Mountains Classification 2026 Vuelta

1. Santiago Buitrago 78
2. Wout van Aert 62
3. Andreas Leknessund 36
4. Mikel Landa 30
5. Tobias Halland Johannessen 28
